title: Dianna Russini bragged about using NFL coach to get out of ticket

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dianna Russini bragged about using NFL coach to get out of ticket
sources.description: Former NFL insider Dianna Russini was back in the spotlight this week after a New York Times article highlighted an incident when she was pulled over by police in January for texting and driving and called an NFL coach to help get her out of a ticket.
